scope: Historical measurements of original candidate commit 07b9037439dd81e45ec1862fce0d3850ec152bd8 against frozen correctness-fixed B1. Not post-review repair performance or a claim that original correctness gaps were covered. Complete numeric samples for selected headline paths and all 144 implementation attempts; no provider payloads, credentials, endpoint addresses or private workspace paths.

paired_analysis.scope: Existing-data analysis, no new execution. Ratios candidate/reference; paired ratios are not ratios of marginal medians. Ranges are observed extrema, not confidence intervals. Three repetitions per task are insufficient for a reliable live p95 or small causal speed/quality claim.
paired_analysis.pairing: Paired implementation rows match external scheduled repetition and task, never the raw row.repetition=0. Controls match provider/task/repetition within their recorded arm schedule.
